description: Whether the access controls the product promises are technically enforced, measured by an automated attack matrix rather than by inspection.

metrics.description: Occasions on which one workspace could reach another workspace's data.
metrics.measurementMethod: Run the full authorization matrix: every actor against every resource of a foreign workspace, including direct identifier tampering with valid UUIDs. Count any response that is not a denial.
metrics.standardReference: OWASP ASVS v5.0, V4 Access Control; OWASP Top Ten 2021 A01 Broken Access Control.

metrics.description: Endpoints that act on an identifier without verifying ownership.
metrics.measurementMethod: For each resource-scoped endpoint, substitute a valid identifier belonging to another workspace and require a not-found or forbidden response.
metrics.standardReference: OWASP ASVS v5.0, V4.2 Operation Level Access Control.

metrics.description: Time between a successful revocation write and the first denial of a newly initiated privileged operation.
metrics.measurementMethod: Record the revocation commit timestamp, then immediately attempt a question, a preview fetch and a download; take the latest first-denial timestamp and subtract.

metrics.description: Deviation between the stored expiry instant and the moment protected operations begin to be refused.
metrics.measurementMethod: Set an expiry a short interval ahead using the server clock, poll a protected operation, and record the delta between expiry and first denial. Browser clocks are never consulted.

metrics.description: Ways in which the original file remains reachable while downloads are disabled.
metrics.measurementMethod: With downloads off, drive the viewer and inspect every network response: count any that returns the original bytes, any redirect to an object-store URL, and any reachable download endpoint.

metrics.description: Validity window of any signed URL that points at an original file.
metrics.measurementMethod: Read the expiry encoded in each minted download URL. A long-lived URL would leave download policy effectively open after it is switched off.

metrics.description: Share of adversarial documents that succeeded in redirecting the assistant.
metrics.measurementMethod: Index the attack corpus, ask a normal question of each Companion, and count answers that follow the injected instruction, reveal the policy prompt, or cite a fabricated source.
metrics.standardReference: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, LLM01 Prompt Injection.

metrics.description: Share of a protected document that one recipient session managed to extract verbatim.
metrics.measurementMethod: Accumulate the verbatim characters returned to a session, measure their overlap against the source text, and divide by the document's total length.

metrics.description: Password guessing against a protected link is throttled before it becomes viable.
metrics.measurementMethod: Issue wrong passwords in a loop and require a rate-limited response within the configured window.
metrics.standardReference: OWASP ASVS v5.0, V2.2 General Authenticator Requirements.

metrics.description: Secrets stored or transmitted in a recoverable form.
metrics.measurementMethod: Scan stored password and token columns for values that are not a recognised hash, and scan client bundles for credential-shaped strings.
metrics.standardReference: OWASP ASVS v5.0, V6 Stored Cryptography.

metrics.description: Responses missing a required security header.
metrics.measurementMethod: Request a representative page of each class and assert the centrally configured header set is present and correctly valued.

metrics.description: Recipient share links that a crawler would be permitted to index.
metrics.measurementMethod: Fetch a share link and assert noindex and nofollow in both the response header and the document metadata, and that no share slug appears in the sitemap.
